revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the risk reviewer framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The risk review no longer accepts a plan that is only good in the central case. The same front-office choices have to make sense across the cases in the data pack, while the case-specific consequences settle afterward. Mary is planning a weekday dinner and a weekend dinner together rather than one isolated meal. The pair must share the same shopping logic, respect the prep-time limits `max_prep_time_weekday` and `max_prep_time_weekend`, keep banned weekend proteins out of the weekend plate, and avoid using a protein label on paper unless that protein appears in at least one of the two meals. Vegetable swings between the two nights count against the weekly fiber goal through `veg_balance_penalty`. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
